sentences.sk: V sobotu ráno ide Martin do malej kaviarne.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning Martin goes to a small café.

sentences.sk: Kaviareň je blízko jeho domu.
sentences.en: The café is close to his house.

sentences.sk: Pri okne sedí jeho kamarátka Lucia.
sentences.en: His friend Lucia is sitting by the window.

sentences.sk: Martin ju pozdraví a sadne si k nej.
sentences.en: Martin greets her and sits down with her.

sentences.sk: Na stole je jedálny lístok a pohár vody.
sentences.en: There is a menu and a glass of water on the table.

sentences.sk: Lucia chce horúci čaj a niečo malé na raňajky.
sentences.en: Lucia wants hot tea and something small for breakfast.

sentences.sk: Martin má hlad, preto si objedná vajíčka a chlieb.
sentences.en: Martin is hungry, so he orders eggs and bread.

sentences.sk: Čašníčka sa pýta, či chce aj kávu.
sentences.en: The waitress asks if he also wants coffee.

sentences.sk: Martin povie, že dnes chce radšej džús.
sentences.en: Martin says that today he would rather have juice.

sentences.sk: Lucia sa usmeje a objedná si jogurt s ovocím.
sentences.en: Lucia smiles and orders yogurt with fruit.

sentences.sk: Čašníčka prinesie nápoje veľmi rýchlo.
sentences.en: The waitress brings the drinks very quickly.

sentences.sk: Čaj je teplý a Martinov džús je studený.
sentences.en: The tea is warm, and Martin’s juice is cold.

sentences.sk: Pri jedle sa rozprávajú o svojom týždni.
sentences.en: While eating, they talk about their week.

sentences.sk: Lucia má novú prácu v kníhkupectve.
sentences.en: Lucia has a new job in a bookshop.

sentences.sk: Martin jej povie, že sa teší na voľný deň.
sentences.en: Martin tells her that he is looking forward to a day off.

sentences.sk: Po raňajkách si chcú pozrieť trh na námestí.
sentences.en: After breakfast they want to see the market in the square.

sentences.sk: Čašníčka položí účet na stôl.
sentences.en: The waitress puts the bill on the table.

sentences.sk: Martin a Lucia zaplatia spolu.
sentences.en: Martin and Lucia pay together.

sentences.sk: Pred odchodom poďakujú a povedia dovidenia.
sentences.en: Before leaving, they say thank you and goodbye.

sentences.sk: Vonku je pekný deň a obaja majú dobrú náladu.
sentences.en: It is a nice day outside, and both are in a good mood.

glossary.note: Feminine noun; a place to have coffee or a small meal.
Used with the genitive: blízko domu.
Third person singular; si means ordering for oneself.
Accusative singular of the feminine noun káva; it is the thing someone wants.
Accusative plural of masculine noun nápoj; it is the object of prinesie.
Masculine noun; here it means the café bill.

questions.explanationEn: Lucia is sitting by the window.

questions.promptSk: Čo si Martin objedná na jedenie?

questions.explanationEn: They want to see the market in the square.
